description: C4 (decision C4-8): the old toll-keep's development - its first tier is C2's aftermath (the keep opened once the Broken Warden has fallen: an auto project), its second the breach he stood in mended with a gate of his own ashlar, which the giant carries.

ashlar.name: ashlar block
ashlar.from: the keep's yard, where the masons stack the Warden's fallen stone

tiers.name: The Toll Road
tiers.text: The toll fort on the King's Road, and above it the old keep a titan holds.

tiers.name: The Keep Opened
tiers.text: With the Warden fallen, masons work his keep; its mason-forge works his stone.

unlocks.text: The keep's mason-forge works the Warden's stone (the Bastion set).

projects.name: The keep opened
projects.text: The masons go up into the keep once you have gone.

tiers.name: The Breach Mended
tiers.text: The breach the Warden stood in is closed by a gate between piers of his own ashlar.

unlocks.text: The masons raise a waystone at the keep's gate.
The masons trade gate-iron for ashlar.

projects.name: Mend the breach
projects.text: Hode's masons can build piers but not lift the stones that close a titan's breach. Two of the Warden's ashlar blocks into its gap, and gate-iron for its hinges.
projects.raise: Set the gate between its piers
projects.raised_text: The gate swings shut on its new hinges. The masons cheer from the wall.

needs.text: Carry two ashlar blocks into the breach
